_comment: §2c run 2, at the end of slice C. Same fixed script as the baseline
⚠ Contamination, unchanged and still biasing TOWARD competence: the subagent
inherits AGENTS.md through its system prompt. NEW this run: the live checkout
was being edited underneath it, which broke its first `cargo doc`; it worked
around that by building against a read-only `git archive` of HEAD. That is an
environment artifact, not an engine defect, and it is recorded because a
measurement whose interference is written down is worth more than one that
harness: fresh general-purpose subagent, no inherited conversation context

completed.notes: BOTH faces, against baseline's headless-only. Windowed proven in the GPU-less form the engine documents; a real window is impossible on this box (no display server). The build was clean FIRST TRY — the patch-table instructions were correct and sufficient — and it needed no `bevy` dependency, confirming slice B's claim.

first_engine_file_reason: To find where `RoomSpec` and `RoomMetadata` live. `ModuleDraft::playable` takes `Vec<RoomSpec>` and `ModuleDraft::room` takes `RoomMetadata`; neither was reachable from `ambition_platformer2d::app::prelude`, rustdoc with --no-deps rendered both as unlinked text, and rustc offered NO import suggestion for `RoomSpec`. CLOSED the same day: the prelude now re-exports both, guarded by `the_app_prelude_carries_the_room_types_its_signatures_require`.

engine_api_surfaces_read.looking_for: the real method list, because api-prototype.md §3 says its own example is illustrative — this is where it learned no_characters/no_audio/playable/host_status exist at all
where RoomSpec/RoomMetadata live (did not answer it)
why its host hung, and the character-roster RON schema

compared_to_baseline.reading: The first-file field moved from 'I cannot compile this' to 'I cannot find one type', which is the campaign working: the blocker got smaller and more specific. §4.2 still fails — the gate is ZERO engine files.

findings.severity: highest — cost the run real time
findings.summary: docs/sdk/ was last touched at c01d771bd while slices B and C landed no_characters/no_audio/playable/host_status/EMPTY_CHARACTER_ROSTER_RON/world::prelude/minimal_game. Its 'Known gaps' actively claimed a minimal module CANNOT reach a windowed host and that there is NO way to ask whether the game started. Both were false at HEAD.
findings.agents_words: a doc advertising gaps that no longer exist does the same thing
findings.why_it_matters: The README's own thesis is that hiding gaps sends readers into crates/. Advertising phantom gaps is the same defect wearing the opposite sign, and it was introduced by the campaign that wrote the thesis.

findings.summary: A `starting_character` no roster contained was accepted by try_build; 120 ticks ran, the process exited 0, the host never started. The agent flagged it as a FALSE POSITIVE against itself and only caught it by adding host_status.
findings.agents_words: the exact silent-failure shape slice A closed for routes, left open for characters
findings.fix: Validated at build; refusal names the character and lists the ones that exist. Test: a_starting_character_no_roster_contains_is_refused_at_build.

findings.summary: 'not registered by any mounted capability' sent the agent looking for how to write a capability plugin; the actual fix is `playable()`. The message also carried ~30 spaces of source indentation into its output.
findings.fix: Indentation fixed. Naming `playable` as the likely fix is still open.

findings.summary: no_characters() exists but playable() requires a starting character, and without playable() no gameplay route is registered. A menu-only app cannot compose. Now stated in the SDK's Known gaps and asserted by declaring_no_cast_and_a_starting_character_is_refused.

`ambition_platformer2d::bevy` is re-exported without Bevy's `debug` feature, so World::inspect_entity reports '<Enable the debug feature to see the name>' for everything — removing the one generic tool a consumer has for 'what did the engine spawn?'.
EMPTY_CHARACTER_ROSTER_RON covers the empty case; a game with ONE character is the actual minimal case and every required field is undocumented. The agent copied a fixture verbatim.

what_worked: The patch-table paragraph: 'accurate, prominent, and load-bearing — my build resolved and compiled first try because of it.' That was blind run 1's top finding, closed, and confirmed closed by run 2.
try_build's composition errors: 'genuinely good (three problems named at once, each with its consequence)'.
A minimal game needs exactly one dependency. The claim held under an independent build.
verdict: Both faces reached, engine surfaces read halved, and the blocker moved from 'cannot compile' to 'cannot locate one type'. §4.2 still fails: the gate is ZERO engine files and this run opened one.
